requirements.negative_control: remove a node from the inventory and the check fails
requirements.statement: Declared inventory equals collected and executed nodes

requirements.negative_control: a results-first contract fails
requirements.statement: Contract, scope and registry are frozen before any result is recorded

requirements.negative_control: an extra section or purpose fails
requirements.statement: Scope binds the B6-I5 construction sequence rows exactly

requirements.negative_control: an unlocked later stage fails
requirements.statement: B6-I6 through I9 stay locked and recurring cost stays zero

requirements.negative_control: a missing export fails
requirements.statement: Every declared knowledge, artifact, evaluation and provenance symbol is exported

requirements.negative_control: an I6 import fails
requirements.statement: No later-stage dependency is imported or referenced

requirements.negative_control: the registry drops tenant, project or scope
requirements.statement: The knowledge registry is canonical and scoped by tenant, project and scope

requirements.negative_control: a fact without a source or digest is accepted
requirements.statement: A governed fact without a source reference and digest is refused

requirements.negative_control: two facts share one fact id
requirements.statement: A duplicate fact id is refused deterministically

requirements.negative_control: a retrieval crosses a project boundary
requirements.statement: Cross-tenant, cross-project and out-of-scope retrieval is refused

requirements.negative_control: an unpromoted fact is returned
requirements.statement: A fact is retrievable only after an accepted promotion decision

requirements.negative_control: the knowledge service writes to agent memory
requirements.statement: Knowledge storage stays separate from agent memory and shares no mutable store

requirements.negative_control: reordered input changes the digest
requirements.statement: Fact retrieval order and digest are deterministic

requirements.negative_control: a registered artifact is re-registered with new bytes
requirements.statement: An artifact is immutable after registration

requirements.negative_control: two artifacts claim one id and version
requirements.statement: A duplicate artifact id and version is refused

requirements.negative_control: different bytes are served for a registered digest
requirements.statement: A served artifact whose bytes differ from its digest is refused

requirements.negative_control: a manifest hash or size row is edited
requirements.statement: A manifest whose hash or size row differs from the artifact is refused

requirements.negative_control: retrieval names an unregistered artifact
requirements.statement: Retrieval of a never-registered artifact is refused

requirements.negative_control: a superseded version is returned as current
requirements.statement: A stale or unknown artifact version is refused rather than served as latest

requirements.negative_control: an actor outside the scope retrieves
requirements.statement: Retrieval without scope authorization is refused

requirements.negative_control: an invented storage or retention class is accepted
requirements.statement: Only the frozen storage and retention classes are accepted

requirements.negative_control: an unregistered evaluator runs
requirements.statement: Only a registered evaluator may be executed

requirements.negative_control: the builder swaps the evaluator definition
requirements.statement: A builder cannot silently change the evaluator; a differing digest is refused

requirements.negative_control: a recorded result is overwritten in place
requirements.statement: A recorded evaluation result cannot be replaced in place

requirements.negative_control: results from two evaluator versions are compared
requirements.statement: A comparison refuses results from different evaluator versions

requirements.negative_control: the gate decision is authored by the builder
requirements.statement: A gate decision requires an approver independent of the builder

requirements.negative_control: approver equals builder
requirements.statement: Self-approval is refused

requirements.negative_control: promotion with a failed or absent gate
requirements.statement: Promotion requires a passing gate result and an independent approver

requirements.negative_control: a missing chain stage fails
requirements.statement: The provenance chain reconciles fact, artifact, evaluation and decision end-to-end

requirements.negative_control: a link points at the wrong parent digest
requirements.statement: A broken provenance link or digest is refused

requirements.negative_control: a decision with no provenance row
requirements.statement: A decision without a provenance record is refused

requirements.negative_control: an artifact is substituted inside the chain
requirements.statement: Tamper and substitution anywhere in the chain are detected

requirements.negative_control: an artifact row cites a fact digest that does not exist
requirements.statement: Every artifact row is bound to the fact digest that justified it

requirements.negative_control: a result cites an unregistered artifact digest
requirements.statement: Every evaluation result is bound to a registered artifact digest
